notes: Network to county sites and the SOS opened about 14:07 UTC; Lubbock work was done after that. Results archive found by search: votelubbock.gov/election-information/historical-election-results/ (title 'Lubbock County, TX Elections'). The fetch module reached votelubbock.gov but every request (historical results page twice, including --refresh, the home page, and the Central Counting Station Plan PDF) returned HTTP 202 with an empty body (content_hash e3b0c44298fc..., the empty-content hash), which looks like a bot-challenge interstitial, so no page text could be read. Search summaries say the archive holds precinct-by-precinct and cumulative reports for 2024 and 2026 elections, but no file names, run times, or posting times were visible, so platform is left unknown and timing is not evidenced. A search summary mentioned a night when the Lubbock County Elections office said results were delayed because of a ballot printer issue (lead only, election not identified). Search result titles show leadership change in 2026 ('Lubbock County names new elections administrator', fox34.com 2026-07-02; 'New Lubbock County Elections Administrator calls role a calling', kcbd.com 2026-09-04); no source ties that to precinct-level reporting, so stated_change_2026 is n. Contact from the TX SOS county election officials list fetched via the fetch module (Lubbock County, Elections Administrator Troy Havard, '(806) 775-1776', County Email Address mailto votelubbock@lubbockcounty.gov). A search summary also gave (806) 775-1339 (lead only, not used). Wayback probe for the archive path failed (robots_disallowed_or_unreachable). WebFetch to everythinglubbock.com was EGRESS_BLOCKED. Usage notice: page could not be read, left empty.
tag_rationale: The county results archive could not be read (bot challenge) and no news or county source states when precinct-level results appeared on election night.
